title: Hearty Japanese Genmaicha Noodles
description: A quick-fix Japanese dish featuring genmaicha, score-fat, and plant-based-friendly ingredients, traditionally served in an agave-leaf vessel.
instructions: Bring the brewed genmaicha tea to a simmer in a large pot.
Add the soba noodles to the pot and cook according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the score-fat over medium heat.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms to the pan and cook until they are tender.
Add the chopped green onions to the pan and cook for an additional minute.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sesame oil, soy sauce, and rice vinegar.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan with the mushrooms and green onions.
Pour the sesame oil mixture over the noodles and toss to combine.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with additional green onions if desired.
